ProxyCredentials.description: A forward proxy's Basic credentials, derived from the seed.

description:
The first line `serve` prints once its listeners are bound: where it
answers, what it serves and where its network fixtures listen.

address.description: The address it answers on, such as `127.0.0.1:51234`.

certificate_authority.description: The certificate authority its TLS leaves chain to, as PEM.

network.description: The network profile it serves under and how it shapes traffic.

proxies.description:
Each forward proxy's address, by name: `open`, `refusing_tunnels`,
`down` (nothing listens), and one per proxy kind behind Basic
authentication.

proxy_credentials.description: The credentials the authenticated proxies accept.

seed.description: The seed every page and expected result comes from.

target.description: The watched target's address, which answers `200 reached`.

udp.description:
The UDP fixture's address, whose every datagram the connection
record lists.

title: ServeLine
